messages.content:
You are walking along a straight corridor 1.75 m wide. Another person, Person 2, is walking ahead of you the same way, 3 m ahead, in the middle of the corridor, as you are, and you are overtaking them. You will move to your left to pass. Tell Person 2 which side of them you will pass on, using their left or right: what do you say?

Answer on the first line with your answer only (a word, a short phrase or a lane number), then give one sentence saying why on the next line.

raw_output:
On your left.  
Because you and Person 2 are facing the same direction, your left is also Person 2’s left.
